data.title: 波岛出海 · 东京夏Comi摊位前的战意爆发
data.description: 东京Big Sight漫展西馆人潮汹涌的展厅内，热浪与快门闪光交织。出海双手按在堆满新刊同人志的桌面上，胸前挂着参展牌，双马尾飞舞，元气满满地向读者鞠躬招揽。
data.location: bustling Tokyo Big Sight convention hall booth crowded with anime banners and fan book stacks
data.action: leaning forward over display table lined with artbooks, arms spread, shouting enthusiastic greeting with radiant beaming smile
data.lighting: 漫展展馆巨大天顶聚光射灯与闪光灯
data.promptProse: Izumi leans energetically across her doujinshi booth at the crowded comic convention, greeting readers with wide beaming pride and bouncing twintails.
data.animaCaption: Exhibition hall floodlights illuminate her colorful artbook display as she welcomes visitors.
